parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: Configuration ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListRedirectRules](~~2867474~~) interface.

parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
Configuration type. Possible values:
- global: Global configuration.
- rule: Rule-based configuration.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) interface.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: Version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the effective version of the site configuration, defaulting to version 0.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-compression-rules --site-id 340035003100000 --config-id 352816096980000 --config-type rule --rule-name rule_example --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --site-version 0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListCompressionRules --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 340035003100000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --ConfigId 352816096980000 --ConfigType rule --SiteVersion 0 --RuleName rule_example
